author: ElZane87
body:
Mammon was pissed and made the Gods, and a lot of Deities/semi Deities "fall" down to Orna-Earth. They mad now and that's why you fight them.  


Apollyon wanted to stop him but turned out the cure was worse than the disease or sth, so good old lady Morrigan defeated him but he always comes back. Than the hag did what hags do and went mad as well.   


So we fight them ~~for sweet sweet loot~~ to restore order and stuff.

author: Engrada
body:
[Mammon ](https://i.imgur.com/iuk52Rz.jpg) seems to be the source of the Falling (the darkness that surround the player?). 

He was born of mankind's hubris and negativity. 

The Fomorians are a race of fallen elves transfigured by the falling into the species we battle today. 

The main Villian and final story boss is Mammon. 

The good guys are any alive humans/elves/Dudley you see on the world map, as well.as your character and their party. 

The underlying conflict is the continued survival and growth in a world full of darkness. You battle back the forces of darkness.

Might not be 100% accurate but I tried. Hope it helps.
